description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source test management tool. It handles the unassignment of testers from test plans based on build IDs, including initializing request arguments and GUI states, checking user rights, and performing database operations related to test assignments.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic, empty class used to create objects for passing data structures.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A templating engine class used for rendering the HTML output.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments, and retrieves session variables related to build ID, confirmation, user, and test project.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with relevant titles, messages, and button states based on the current context.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the necessary rights ('testplan_planning') to access this functionality.
